name: add_data_validation
representative_why: Users need controlled inputs so repeated workbook updates do not introduce invalid statuses, categories, or rates.
representative_how: supported runtime scope is currently limited to explicit list/dropdown rules
verification_strategy: Inspect workbook data validation rules and confirm the allowed list values match the compiled rule while preserving the source workbook. Numeric bounds, date windows, formula-backed lists, and referential integrity remain future opportunity scope.
